snippet.title: Hemlon the Grey - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The world that was called as the era of light now is covered with darkness. Prosperous kingdoms was fallen, the republic that succeeded the kingdoms are corrupted, and the glory of the old era. With Grief Ender, the sword of Hemlon, give rest to Defileds and uncovered secrets of half-demon warriors and Republic of Reinz.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348370/Hemlon_the_Grey/

Developer: Micharii 
X: https://x.com/micharie_games

#indiegame #pixelart #soulslike
